scoring_notes: Mis-expands RAG and discusses diversity rather than an external retriever, document index, passages, and grounded generation.
Explains contextual risk assessment and prioritisation, but affected groups, environmental harms, documentation, and monitoring are under-specified.
Recognises lawful and fair processing and limitations of aggregate accuracy, but does not cleanly distinguish personal-data accuracy from test performance.
Directly explains browser UI, chat completions, multi-user serving, and why HTTP access is more useful than CLI-only execution.
Recognises multi-source nuance but omits the required RAG, llama.cpp, trustworthiness, data-protection, and resource-priority synthesis.
Discusses only RAG benchmark performance and fails to address local runtime, hardware, inference location, privacy, or complementary functions.
Avoids answering and says context is insufficient; it does not explain factual context, evaluator comparison, or residual hallucination risk.
Correctly explains reduced bit precision, lower memory, and faster processing; it omits the possible quality trade-off and benchmarking need.
Explains distinction between capabilities and trustworthiness, but does not clearly enumerate privacy, fairness, accountability, transparency, and conditional recommendations.
Strong risk, rights, impacts, and management explanation; voluntary status and full design-to-evaluation lifecycle are not explicit.
Substantive security and minimisation response, though concrete data-flow documentation and deletion of intermediate files are not clearly evidenced.
Covers data leakage and deployment risks, but the visible response does not clearly enumerate all logs, caches, backups, dependencies, and access controls.
Vaguely discusses privacy attacks but does not identify the main model-size, memory, compute, format, setup, and device constraints.
Recognises integration benefits but frames compatibility generically and omits local chat completions, reduced code changes, and avoiding cloud calls.
Connects deployment with data collection, storage, consent, and security, but under-specifies GGUF, local server logs, dependencies, minimisation, and access control.
Complete explanation of lightweight local HTTP serving, OpenAI compatibility, web UI, and application access.
Identifies local exposure and network threats, but omits several specific storage, vector database, cache, backup, dependency, and output risks.
Correctly describes a portable local model format and conversion, but incorrectly calls GGUF a Google format and omits quantisation emphasis.
Recognises stored parametric knowledge and retrieval value, but focuses on fine-tuning and omits updates, explanation, provenance, and hallucination.
Connects technical features to privacy, security, bias, and transparency but omits concrete local runtime, logging, dependency, access, and minimisation choices.
Correctly says local processing remains in scope and controller obligations remain, but concrete security, minimisation, retention, and accountability duties are incomplete.
Correctly says the retriever finds relevant information for generation, but does not clearly specify query, document index, top passages, and context.
Useful risk taxonomy and communication framing, but omits privacy-enhanced trustworthiness and local deployment controls and trade-offs.
Describes privacy-preserving querying rather than local deployment and omits continuing lawful processing, transparency, security, minimisation, logging, retention, and access duties.
Identifies learned retrieval and improved factuality, but does not clearly explain the external index, retrieved passages, and conditioning of the generator.
Explains combining retrieval and generation for knowledge-intensive questions, but incompletely covers updates, provenance, external precision, and unsupported generation.
Strong limits, harms, responsible use, and proactive management explanation; context dependence and uncertainty could be more explicit.
Lists system documentation and data preparation rather than the paper's open-domain QA, abstractive QA, question generation, and fact verification tasks.
Strongly connects trustworthiness, risk level, resource prioritisation, context, and controls to practical deployment; acceptable trade-offs are implicit.
Correct minimal-setup local inference purpose, but omits GGUF quantisation, hardware backends, llama-cli, and llama-server.
